claims.claim: Intel CFO comments indicate 18A wafers intended for Panther Lake are being taken offline so Oregon can run Intel 3 and produce more data-centre wafers.
claims.episode_span: taking 18A wafers that had been going to Panther Lake offline
claims.source_title: Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES
claims.supporting_quote: What we're taking offline to put Intel 3 into Oregon is 18A wafers, which were generally going to build Panther Lake products, so we see the opportunity with some of that capacity freed up to go produce more data center wafers.

claims.claim: Lip-Bu Tan said Nova Lake is Intel's first 18A-P client product, is tracking ahead of schedule, and is expected to have twice Panther Lake's design wins at launch, with more at CES in January.
claims.episode_span: the first 18A-P client product and is tracking ahead of schedule
claims.source_title: Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES
claims.supporting_quote: Nova Lake, our first Intel 18A-P client product, is tracking ahead of schedule, with design wins expecting to be twice those of Panther Lake at launch," Tan said in his prepared remarks. "We look forward to sharing more at CES in January.

claims.claim: Compared with 18A, 18A-P offers a 9 percent speed improvement at the same power or an 18 percent power reduction at the same speed, and Intel has described it as a drop-in replacement.
claims.episode_span: 18A-P is a 9 percent speed gain at the same power, or an 18 percent power cut
claims.source_title: Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES
claims.supporting_quote: Compared to 18A, which is available in Panther Lake and Wildcat Lake products currently, 18A-P comes with a 9% improvement in speed at iso-power, or an 18% reduction in power at iso-speed.

claims.claim: Intel said Wildcat Lake demand is outstripping supply, expects client business to decline more than 20 percent next quarter, and expects 2026 PC-unit TAM to decline about 12 percent.
claims.episode_span: Demand for Wildcat Lake is outstripping supply.
claims.source_title: Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES
claims.supporting_quote: Demand for our Wildcat Lake is outstripping supply," said Tan.
